name: Inverse Volatility Portfolio: SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC
description: Weekly-rebalanced inverse volatility portfolio across SPY (equities), TLT (bonds), GLD (gold), and DBC (commodities). Weights are proportional to inverse 63-day realized volatility, summing to 100%. Lower-vol assets receive higher allocation, providing natural risk diversification. Rebalanced at weekly boundaries.
source:
# Inverse Volatility Portfolio: SPY / TLT / GLD / DBC
# Weekly rebalance, 63-day vol lookback, 100% invested
# Lower volatility assets get higher weight

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# --- Rebalance Detection ---
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# --- Volatility Estimation ---
# 63-day annualized vol (feeds price levels, not returns — per S47)
vol = volatility(period=63)(close)

# --- Signal: Always Long All Assets ---
# All 4 assets are permanently held — this is a strategic allocation
always_long = True

# --- Inverse Volatility Weights ---
# inv_vol_weight normalizes so weights sum to 1.0 across active assets
# Lower vol → higher weight (natural risk balancing)
ivw = inv_vol_weight()(active_mask=always_long, volatility=vol)
weight_pct = ivw.weight * 100

# --- Execution ---
# Long-only: all assets always held
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=always_long)

# Size by inverse vol weights, locked between weekly rebalances
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weight_pct, rebalance_on=is_new_week)
